items.text: Bears placing TE Cole Kmet on IR due to serious knee injury suffered Thursday night vs Patriots.
items.why: Serious knee injury, carted off non-contact, coach said didn't look good; confirmed IR.
items.implication: Season-ending likely; opens TE snaps/routes for Loveland and more 11 personnel juice for Burden.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/snaps for Colston Loveland and Luther Burden; reduced 2/3 TE sets.

items.text: Colts HC Shane Steichen ruled out TE Tyler Warren (groin) for Sunday vs Vikings.
items.why: Groin injury; missed practice, second straight game out.
items.implication: Colts TE targets redistribute; hurts IND passing volume vs strong MIN D.
items.opportunity: Backup TEs or WRs for residual targets; negative for Colts skill players.

items.text: Puka Nacua calf injury believed minor after tests but status up in the air for Sunday vs Raiders; left practice Thursday.
items.why: Calf injury in practice; tests show more minor than significant but availability unclear.
items.implication: GTD; if out, Rams WR depth thin with Adams on IR; if in, high volume expected.
items.opportunity: If OUT, TE targets rise (Higbee/Parkinson); if IN, 25-tgt pace possible post-Ferguson delay.

items.text: Lamar Jackson dealing with high ankle sprain but 'heading in the right direction'; came out for Friday practice after limited prior sessions; missed last two games.
items.why: High ankle sprain; encouraging practice signs and player comments.
items.implication: Likely return boosts BAL offense vs CIN; monitor final status.
items.opportunity: Full role if active; handcuff/backup implications reverse.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) ruled out this week after high-ankle sprain; trying to get right.
items.why: High-ankle sprain; coach Mike LaFleur ruled out.
items.implication: ARI RB snaps to backups; negative volume.

items.text: Bucs HC Todd Bowles said Baker Mayfield 'looks like he’s ready to go' and is expected to start Sunday vs Panthers.
items.why: Coach comments post-practice; return from injury.
items.implication: Stabilizes TB offense/pace up vs CAR; benefits skill players.
items.opportunity: Increased pass volume/pace for Bucky Irving, Egbuka etc.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet injury may reduce 2-/3-TE sets giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Route rate low but efficiency high; Kmet OUT/IR opens personnel.
items.implication: Burden ROS/weekly upside rises with more routes.
items.opportunity: Increased route share/snaps for Burden; Loveland primary TE.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson not expected ready off IR soon; Rams only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game post-Adams.
items.why: Ferguson delay + Adams IR leaves Puka as primary.
items.opportunity: 25-tgt pace; TE residual if Puka limited.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% of snaps over last three weeks.
items.implication: Limited fantasy floor/ceiling until role expands.
items.opportunity: Low current opportunity; monitor for change.

items.text: 10 Facts: Stroud 6th QB last 3 wks (4th YPG season); Nix 5.4 aDOT (no deep); Week6 Mike Washington 33% snaps ~Jeanty rushes, Jeanty <3 YPC 4/5; Coker out-targeted/outscored McMillan together.
items.why: Stroud form/volume; Nix scheme kills WRs; Jeanty inefficiency opens Washington; Coker > McMillan.
items.implication: Stroud QB1 upside; fade Nix WRs; monitor Jeanty role; prefer Coker.
items.opportunity: Jeanty snap decline risk; Coker targets.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings/lifting/medical at facility (non-football); MarShawn Lloyd 49th EPA/rush, Kaleb Johnson 53rd among qualifiers — both poor, OL mess.
items.why: Facility access positive long-term; backups inefficient.
items.implication: Jacobs ROS outlook solid if returns; avoid backups.
items.opportunity: Jacobs role secure when healthy; poor backup EPA.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs this week on layoff.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, Bears good for yardage, 33% target share/97% routes recently despite drops.
items.why: Usage rebound + matchup; buying the volume.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12): big workloads in friendly matchups; Warren/Irving vs weak RB Ds, Hubbard consistent. Saquon in-line to play vs DAL (efficient prior).
items.why: Workload + matchup juice; Saquon return efficient.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN, Travis Kelce @ SEA, Josh Jacobs @ DET, Cam Skattebo @ HOU: nasty matchups/roles, Jacobs layoff workload Q, Skattebo brutal spot.
items.conflict: Levitan more positive long-term on Jacobs.
